channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bronny James | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bronny James from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Bronny James
item.description:
Speaking on his show, Arenas called out media networks and analysts for never holding European players accountable when they fail to meet expectations.

“They was too busy bashing Bronny for nepotism that they forgot there was a No. 1 pick that they never even mentioned,”

Gilbert Arenas on Bronny James, Oct 14, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Dalton Knecht is not expected to make the Lakers' regular season roster. Lakers have 16 guaranteed contracts and going into the season you can only have 15 guaranteed contracts. Apparently, Bronny James and Jaden Hardy have been outplaying him in campand he's viewed as the odd man out. And it's crazy because Dalton Knecht seemed to like he had a little bit of promise to him, but after that trade that got voided by the Hornets to bring him in and send Mark Williams to the Lakers, the Lakers voided the trade because of Mark Williams' back. Dalton Knecht just been in purgatory ever since and ultimately I think it ruined him.”

Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
LeBron James on sharing the moment in game 3 with Bronny:

“I believe we scored 10 straight points between the two of us. I think we both had a three and we both had a layup, whatever the case may be. I was able to throw him a lob and we had that mini run between the two of us and that was just something that I would never ever forget. Something that I’ve learned obviously at my elder stage and being 41 years old to kind of like appreciate the small wins in the moment and that was one of the moments where I’ve always like been locked in and that moment right there throwing him the lob seeing him make the three we kind of going back and forth I kind of blanked out for a little bit and just like really just accepted and relished in that moment.”

LeBron James on Bronny James, May 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
Legion Hoops:LeBron James on Bronny:

“He also made a three when they disrespected him and go under on the pick and roll… that was a special moment obviously.”

LeBron James on Bronny James, Apr 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
HoopsHype:LeBron James on Bronny's development:

“I think he's enjoying the process, I think you can obviously ask him more than me. He's not a resident anymore, so we don't talk as much. He has his own place.”

LeBron James on Bronny James, Nov 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Bronny James
item.description:
Kwame Brown on Bronny James:

“This ain't year one. This is year two. This is year two. This don't make no sense. We got high school players better than Bronny. Absolutely got high school players better than Bronny. Bronny was never the best high school player on his team. He was the never the best college player on his team. And he still gets 12 shots in a preseason game where everybody's auditioning where nobody normally passes the ball. Everybody trying to get their [__] off cuz it's new people out there. It ain't just you.”

Kwame Brown on Bronny James, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Bronny James
item.description:
Austin:

“I played with Bronny probably a week ago... I sent Bron a picture of me and Bronny out there and I was like I got all of my money on Bronny. He's got a good swing”

Austin Reaves on Bronny James, Sep 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Bronny James
item.description:
“I remember how athletic Bronny looked at like, maybe, couldn’t have been more than three or four,”

Stephen Curry on Bronny James, Jul 25, 2025. Source: Lakers Daily.

item.title: Dylan Harper on Bronny James
item.description:
“I mean just learning. I think learning how to carry yourself go about certain things but at the end of the day like everyone is their own person. So like Bronny, he ain’t the most out loud spoken guy like Shedeur, very quiet,”

Dylan Harper on Bronny James, Jun 27, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
“But to be able to play in this league and also being able to do it alongside Bronny right now, that's one of the biggest accomplishments and probably the No. 1 accomplishment I've ever been able to do.”

LeBron James on Bronny James, Jan 15, 2025. Source: People.

item.title: Paul George on Bronny James
item.description:
Paul George on Bronny James:

“This is a kid who’s trying to find his way in the NBA and trying to live out his dreams. No one starts out perfect at anything;no one looks great right away. He’s trying to find his rhythm while doing something that no one else has ever done—playing with his father, one of the greatest to ever do it. That could be a whole different level of pressure. As good as it is to have his dad along for the journey, only he can speak to what that’s like.”

Paul George on Bronny James, Oct 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
“To know that those guys will be in attendance tonight while me and Bronny are on the same team is a pretty cool moment in the history of sports,”

LeBron James on Bronny James, Oct 23, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Bronny James
item.description:
Former Lakers big man Kwame Brown, who previously warned that James could turn out to be a bust, slammed the guard, as well as his famous father, superstar LeBron James, in a YouTube video (at 0:20).

“Bronny's performance last night, it was horrendous, like I just don't understand,”

Kwame Brown on Bronny James, Oct 10, 2024. Source: USAToday.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Bronny James
item.description:
Said Redick:

“I went over to Bronny before practice and I was like, 'Dude, you ran six miles.'”

JJ Redick on Bronny James, Oct 3, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JJ Redick on Bronny James
item.description:
JJ Redick:

“I look at Bronny as a young guy I’m very high on as a basketball player. He’s kind of like our first player that we get to mold and help develop. So we’re going to look at the G League as a tool in our player development system. But the thing is, with the LeBron-Bronny dynamic, we’ve talked about it, we’ve thought about it, and we'll get it done—it's going to happen sooner rather than later.”

JJ Redick on Bronny James, Sep 25, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Juan Dixon, Bronny James
item.description:
Kwame Brown on Bronny James:

“But I see a guy who’s athletic that needs to learn how to cut and slash more until he gets more comfortable with shooting. If he doesn’t learn how to play the point guard, I don’t think he’s as strong as David Wesley. At his size — 6’1, 6’2 — he’s the only guy that I’ve seen who could play that spot at the two. If he doesn’t learn how to bring the ball up, he’s going to be a poor man’s Juan Dixon. I think he’ll bounce around. His daddy has enough power with Klutch Sports to keep him in the league, but after that, if he doesn’t learn how to play point, he’s gonna fizzle out.”

Kwame Brown on Juan Dixon, Bronny James, Sep 22, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Bronny James, DJ Burns
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“This is the travesty that people are not realizing. They’re acting like the 55th pick ain’t nothing. But don’t you think the kid from NC State, who is a proven double-double monster, could have been a project? Lose a little weight — this kid is a monster. What’s his name, the center for NC State? DJ Burns. How can you make a case for Bronny James, a guy that had a heart issue, that hadn’t proven anything, against a guy that went to a good school and put up numbers against everybody?”

Kwame Brown on Bronny James, DJ Burns, Sep 22, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Bronny James
item.description:
LeBron on how Bronny’s presence changes his mindset this season:

“I think with that particular part, you know, it’s going to give me a sense of enjoying the moment a little bit more. You know, when you’re so engulfed and you’re in training mode and you’re in determined mode, and you’re so engulfed on the preparation and the process, sometimes you can lose track of some of the things that happen throughout the course of the season where you should celebrate or you should appreciate it a little bit more. So, I think with Bronny being here now, I think I can have a moment or two where I can just sit back and be appreciative of just the moment itself because it doesn’t last forever.”

LeBron James on Bronny James, Sep 21, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeanie Buss on Bronny James
item.description:
Jeanie Buss on Bronny James:

“Yeah, I mean, again, we have to let the kid have an opportunity to play and prove that he should be in a Laker uniform. And everything that we’ve seen from him and about him and his work ethic, just some of the things he’s had to overcome being the son of a big star. He works hard, he’s dedicated. He really wants to do this. And if we can have a roster of players with that same mentality, then I think the sky is the limit.”

Jeanie Buss on Bronny James, Aug 24, 2024. Source: am570lasports.iheart.com.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on LeBron James, Bronny James
item.description:
Udonis Haslem on Bronny James:

“There is no other kid that could possibly be more prepared for this particular situationor who can handle this particular situation. As a father, as a businessman, I've never seen LeBron James and his team and his family and his people throw stuff at the wall just to see if it sticks. They calculate. They don't do that. They are calculated. They are sharp. They are smart. There is nobody more prepared than Bronny James. I'm wishing them the best.”

Udonis Haslem on LeBron James, Bronny James, Jul 31, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bryce James on LeBron James, Bronny James
item.description:
Sam Lance:Bryce James on LeBron and Bronny teaming up for the @Lakers:

“It’s a great feeling knowing my brother, the journey he’s had. He’s come far from the cardiac arrest,all the difficulties that he’s had in his career, college. It’s amazing. I’m ready for them lobs to be honest.”

Bryce James on LeBron James, Bronny James, Jul 12, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Bronny James
item.description:
And what Pelinka specifically admired about James is one of his defensive attributes, while saying he wants to refine his offensive work around the rim.

“We did talk about that point of attack defense as something that we were drawn to and something that Bronny and I talked about in the Chicago combine is also being a rim attacker on offense,”

Rob Pelinka on Bronny James, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Bronny James
item.description:
Austin Rivers:

“How about let's just call it for what it is and let's just accept it. We don't have to talk about anybody else and throw other names out there. We don't need to throw around the word nepotism, discredit all these other guys along the way just because you're trying to make a point that it's okay that they drafted Bronny. I don't like that. They're coaching this into a positive by making everyone else feel negative. Coach Malone is one of the best coaches in basketball. I played with Coach Adelman. Bro, he's a basketball Brainiac.”

Austin Rivers on Bronny James, Jun 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Bronny James
item.description:
Austin Rivers:

“Listen, guys,nepotism has been going on in the NBA for a long, long time. There's coaches, front office. So it shouldn't be a problem with Bronny. That's not how you get over this, bro, all right, because two wrongs don't make a right. The word nepotism is completely negative. It's never been passed along as a positive compliment. So I don't want to hear that it's happened before if it goes around the NBA. Because they named Dave Adelman, Coach Malone, Bickerstaff, Silas. They're naming all these coaching hires, front office hires.”

Austin Rivers on Bronny James, Jun 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Bronny James
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Bronny is going to end up being a better pro than a lot of these players in this draftbecause he has the athleticism, the basketball IQ, plays the game the right way. I think he's going to be a good shooter in the NBA, and I think a lot of people judge Bronny off of his production last year at USC, which is a little skewed because for anybody coming back in the middle of a season and trying to play when everybody's in tip-top shape is hard to do that as a newcomer, as a freshman, as a rookie, miss training camp, miss some of the season, and you come in, it's nearly impossible.”

Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jun 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Bronny James
item.description:
Rob Pelinka on Bronny James:

“Bronny is first and foremost a person of high character. And he’s a young man that works incredibly hard... he had a great draft workout with us where he displayed those qualities.”

Rob Pelinka on Bronny James, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Dan Tolzman on Bronny James
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Raptors assistant GM Dan Tolzman on Rich Paul suggesting that Toronto could be interested in Bronny James:

“I think all these players are guys we're looking at. He's in the mix... Every player on the board we're looking long and hard at and I wouldn't say we've ruled anybody out”

Dan Tolzman on Bronny James, Jun 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
“But for me in my position, I’m just trying to find the best opportunity, whether it’s for Bronny, whether it’s for Rob Dillingham, whether it’s for Terrence Shannon, or Justin Edwards, or KJ Simpson, or Oso Ighodaro. Any [Klutch] guys in our class. That’s the draft.”

Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro, Jun 20, 2024. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Paul George on Derrick White, Bronny James
item.description:
Paul George on Bronny James:

“What's most impressive is just his basketball savviness. He can do it all. I feel like he hasn't shown that he can really be elite at a lot of things, but I think he can be elite at a lot of things. I compare him to the Jrue Holidays, the Derrick Whites—guys that are glue guys that can go do everything on the floor and help you. That's kind of how I see him.”

Paul George on Derrick White, Bronny James, Jun 19, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rich Paul on Bronny James
item.description:
“I got the word out early to teams that if you plan on bringing Bronny in, here's what you need to know:If you won't give him a real deal, there's nothing to talk about. It's hard to get real development on a two-way deal.”

Rich Paul on Bronny James, Jun 19, 2024. Source: RealGM.
